Name: assignment_consistency
Formula text: Create binary x[s,w,t] only for public compatible sensor-weapon-target engagement options.

Name: target_flight_window
Formula text: Selected engagements must respect the target public flight window and feasible detection/interception timing.

Name: sensor_detectability_and_tracking
Formula text: A selected sensor-target pairing must have public positive detection evidence and satisfy required tracking duration.

Name: sensor_channel_capacity
Formula text: For each sensor, assigned tracking workload must not exceed public sensor_channel_capacity.

Name: weapon_reachability
Formula text: A selected weapon-target pairing must have public positive interception evidence.

Name: weapon_inventory
Formula text: For each weapon vehicle, selected launches must not exceed public weapon_inventory.

Name: weapon_firing_interval
Formula text: Selected launches from one weapon vehicle must respect public minimum launch intervals when modeled over time.

Name: joint_sensor_weapon_target_time_compatibility
Formula text: A selected sensor-weapon-target triple must have jointly positive public detection and interception effectiveness.
